description: Frozen settings of the RTL evaluation harness (LLM_RTL_code_generation.md 6.1.3, settings table). The executor's own settings are in executor/executor_config.json; this file pins everything on the evaluation side. Change a setting and results are no longer comparable; bump config_version when you do.

tools.iverilog_version: 12.0 (v12-branch, commit 4fd5291632232fbe1ba49b2c26bb6b2bf1c6c9cf, built into conda env iverilog12)

ladder.estimator: Chen et al. 2021 unbiased pass@k, averaged over problems, from the same n samples per problem

verilog-eval-v2.note: Prompt template, code extraction and pass/fail classification are VerilogEval v2's own (scripts/sv-generate, scripts/sv-iv-analyze). 0 in-context examples and rules off are sv-generate's defaults; pre-register any change.

rtllm-2.note: The design description is the whole prompt, under the executor's default system message. Pass rule: the simulation output contains 'Pass' or 'pass' (auto_run.py), with Icarus in place of VCS. Extraction: the last fenced code block defining the design's module.
